purpose: Non-executable Steam symptom guides for Manual Diagnostics; existing case IDs only

guides.title: Steam will not open
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete Steam data or reinstall Steam just to test whether it starts.
comparison: Check whether Steam appears in the installed-applications list, and try opening it using its normal launcher.
Check whether the main window appears briefly, stays invisible, or reports an error.
interpretations: A missing window does not establish a corrupted installation; startup, display integration, and the installation source must be distinguished.

guides.title: Steam closes immediately after opening
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Keep any existing game saves and settings; avoid clearing Steam folders.
comparison: Note whether Steam exits before showing the library or after you sign in.
Compare with another working application and review only Steam-related crash information from the scan.
interpretations: A crash report for another application cannot confirm a Steam crash.

guides.title: Steam stopped opening after an update
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not roll back your whole operating system based only on a Steam symptom.
comparison: Confirm whether the Steam client, its runtime, or the host system changed recently.
Compare the current failure with the last successful start and available application errors.
interpretations: A coincident update is not proof of which component caused the regression.

guides.title: Steam shows a blank or black window
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not reset the desktop or graphics driver as a first step.
comparison: Check whether the whole Steam window is blank or only a built-in page such as Store or Library.
Check whether the same desktop session can display other graphics-accelerated applications.
interpretations: Blank content may involve Steam web views or graphics rendering; the desktop scan alone cannot select the cause.

guides.title: Steam Store or Community page will not load
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not assume your computer is offline when other websites work.
comparison: Check whether the Steam Library loads locally while the Store or Community page does not.
Compare with another already-working website and note any Steam-specific error message.
interpretations: A working internet connection does not guarantee that Steam services or its embedded browser can be reached.

guides.title: Steam cannot sign in
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Never enter Steam credentials into a troubleshooting form or share a sign-in code.
comparison: Check whether the client shows an authentication error, a connection error, or a request for Steam Guard.
Confirm that your clock is correct; compare with another internet service without disclosing credentials.
interpretations: Sign-in errors can be caused by authentication, time, or connectivity; they are not interchangeable.

guides.title: Steam Guard confirmation does not arrive
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not share Steam Guard codes or recovery information.
comparison: Check which Steam Guard method your account already uses and whether the relevant app or inbox is accessible.
Check that the Steam client is asking for a new code rather than displaying a general network error.
interpretations: Delayed confirmation does not prove the local Steam installation is broken.

guides.title: Steam keeps asking for a password
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not reset your wallet or Steam credentials during a diagnostic test.
comparison: Check whether Steam asks for account sign-in, a KDE Wallet/keyring unlock, or administrator authorization.
Note whether the prompt appears once after login or every time Steam starts.
interpretations: Different password dialogs need different fixes; they should not be treated as a single security problem.

guides.title: Steam stays in Offline Mode
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change your network settings without first checking another internet application.
comparison: Check whether Steam explicitly displays Offline Mode while your normal browser connects.
Look for a Steam-only proxy, connection warning, or server-status message.
interpretations: Steam's offline state does not automatically mean the entire host has no internet.

guides.title: Steam opens but the Library is empty
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete library folders or download games again until the installation location is clear.
comparison: Check whether you are signed into the intended Steam account and whether Library filters are active.
Check whether Steam can still see the existing library locations without changing them.
interpretations: An empty view can reflect account, filter, or library-location differences rather than missing game files.

guides.title: Steam starts but desktop launcher is missing
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not create root-owned shortcuts inside user launcher folders.
comparison: Check whether Steam starts from its installed-applications list even when its menu entry is missing.
Compare the shortcut's target with the installed Steam variant, if its details are visible.
interpretations: A broken shortcut does not mean the Steam client itself cannot run.

guides.title: Two Steam installations appear
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not uninstall either copy until you know which contains your working libraries.
comparison: Check whether the entries refer to Flatpak, a distribution package, or another installation.
Compare their library locations and default launcher before deciding whether to keep both.
interpretations: Multiple sources can have different permissions and data paths; the second entry is not automatically an error.

guides.title: Steam Flatpak will not open
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not remove the Steam Flatpak data directory during troubleshooting.
comparison: Check whether the installed Flatpak is the Steam client and whether its required runtime is present.
Check for a Steam-specific startup error before considering host package changes.
interpretations: A Flatpak startup problem is not automatically a game or Proton problem.

guides.title: Steam Flatpak cannot access a game folder
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not grant unrestricted filesystem access as a general workaround.
comparison: Check where the game library is stored and whether Steam has permission to access that particular location.
Compare a library inside Steam's existing accessible storage with the unavailable external location.
interpretations: Flatpak sandbox access differs from regular Linux file ownership; preserve the narrowest suitable permission.

guides.title: Steam update is stuck or repeats
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not erase Steam program files during an incomplete update.
comparison: Identify whether the stuck operation is a client update, a game update, or a compatibility-tool download.
Record the specific error or stage; compare it after restarting only the Steam client if you choose.
interpretations: An update loop does not identify the failing component without knowing which update it is.

guides.title: Steam client interface appears blurry
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change global display scaling just for a single application.
comparison: Compare Steam text and icons with other applications at the same display scale.
Check whether the blur affects Steam's own window, a game, or only remote streaming.
interpretations: UI scaling and in-game rendering have different causes.

guides.title: Steam overlay does not appear in a game
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete game configuration or Proton data as a first step.
comparison: Check whether the issue occurs in a single game or every game that supports the overlay.
Look at the game's Steam overlay setting and whether its launch mode or compatibility tool differs from working titles.
interpretations: Overlay support may depend on the game, launcher, session, and runtime; absence alone is not a Steam installation fault.

guides.title: Steam Big Picture does not open
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Keep your normal desktop controls available during testing.
comparison: Check whether regular Steam works and whether Big Picture fails to enter fullscreen or freezes.
Compare the selected monitor and desktop session without changing display configuration.
interpretations: A fullscreen presentation failure does not prove the game client is broken.

guides.title: Steam does not remember settings
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change home-directory ownership recursively.
comparison: Check whether other Steam settings persist after a normal exit and restart.
Compare account-specific options with settings for the current local user, without revealing personal data.
interpretations: Unsaved settings may reflect a write-access, profile, or sync problem; the cause remains unproven.

guides.title: Steam download will not start
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not clear your entire downloads directory before checking the error.
comparison: Check whether Steam reports a connection failure, a queued download, or missing disk space.
Compare with normal browsing and with a different already-installed game update if one is queued.
interpretations: A Steam download failure alone is not proof that the host internet is broken.

guides.title: Steam downloads are unexpectedly slow
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not assume the network interface is faulty based on a Steam download-rate graph.
comparison: Compare Steam's displayed download speed and units with normal connection performance.
Check whether the selected download region, disk activity, or a speed limit affects only Steam.
interpretations: Disk unpacking, server selection, and transfer rates can produce similar symptoms.

guides.title: Steam download repeatedly pauses or restarts
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Avoid deleting partially downloaded files while Steam is active.
comparison: Check whether the transfer pauses during download, verification, or disk unpacking.
Record any Steam download error and compare with current free space on the library disk.
interpretations: A pause during installation is not necessarily a network outage.

guides.title: Steam reports a disk write error
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not format the drive or change file ownership across the whole library.
comparison: Identify the affected library drive and check whether it is mounted read-write with available space.
Check whether the problem affects one game or every write to that Steam library.
interpretations: The message may involve access, storage health, or filesystem state; do not assume a damaged disk.

guides.title: Steam says there is not enough disk space
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete game saves or Proton prefixes to free space without a backup.
comparison: Check free space on the exact library destination and the temporary location Steam is using.
Compare the requested download size with unpacking or update space requirements.
interpretations: Free space on another disk does not help an installation writing to a different library.

guides.title: Steam cannot find an external game library
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Safely stop any active transfer before reconnecting external storage.
comparison: Check whether the external drive is currently mounted and visible to the desktop.
Check whether Steam's existing library path still points to that mounted location.
interpretations: An unavailable mount does not mean the games have been deleted.

guides.title: Steam cannot add a new library location
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not create broad write permissions or use administrator-owned library folders.
comparison: Check whether the chosen location is writable by your account and meets the filesystem requirements.
If Steam is a Flatpak, consider the application's sandbox access separately from the filesystem.
interpretations: Write access and sandbox access are distinct; diagnose the correct one first.

guides.title: Steam keeps verifying game files
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not repeatedly delete or redownload a game until its storage is checked.
comparison: Check whether verification happens after each launch, each update, or every Steam startup.
Check the affected library disk's free space and whether other games on that disk behave normally.
interpretations: Repeated verification can involve a particular game or library; it does not prove game corruption.

guides.title: A Steam game is missing after moving the library
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not copy, rename, or remove library directories while Steam is downloading.
comparison: Check which Steam installation and library location you are using now.
Compare the expected location with the locations currently listed in Steam Storage settings.
interpretations: An unlisted library can look like a missing game even when its files remain on disk.

guides.title: Steam says game files are corrupt
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Back up custom game files and saved data before verifying or repairing anything.
comparison: Check whether Steam reports a corrupt download, failed verification, or a crash after launch.
Compare other games installed on the same filesystem to narrow the affected scope.
interpretations: A corrupt file report does not on its own identify whether storage, download, or local changes caused it.

guides.title: Steam game download is stuck on patching
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not interrupt an ongoing disk write solely because network traffic has stopped.
comparison: Check whether Steam is downloading, unpacking, patching, or verifying.
Check free space and disk activity on the game library, not just network throughput.
interpretations: Some update stages use the disk more than the network; a pause in network transfer is not a failure by itself.

guides.title: A native Linux game will not start
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not force Proton on a native game before checking its existing launch setup.
comparison: Check whether Steam is launching a native build or a compatibility-tool build.
Record the game's specific error and compare with another native game if available.
interpretations: Native runtime, libraries, and display integration differ from Proton problems.

guides.title: A Windows game will not launch through Proton
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete the game's Proton prefix; it can contain game configuration and saves.
comparison: Check the game's current compatibility-tool selection in Steam Properties.
Check whether the game stops before any window appears or shows a launcher or error dialog.
interpretations: Proton compatibility is game-specific; failure does not prove a Linux driver problem.

guides.title: A game shows Playing and then stops
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Protect saved games before changing compatibility versions.
comparison: Check whether a game window or launcher appeared before Steam returned to Play.
Compare with another installed title and note whether this game uses Proton or Linux-native mode.
interpretations: A quick exit may involve game code, runtime, dependencies, or anti-cheat; more evidence is needed.

guides.title: A game opens to a black screen
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Avoid changing system graphics drivers based only on one game.
comparison: Check whether the game has sound or input despite a black image.
Compare another game and confirm whether the problem occurs before or after a splash screen.
interpretations: Rendering, fullscreen mode, and game content can cause different black-screen symptoms.

guides.title: A game crashes after a Proton update
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete the Proton prefix or blindly overwrite game files.
comparison: Check which compatibility tool was used when the game last worked and what it uses now.
Compare other Proton titles without changing their tool selection.
interpretations: A version change is a clue, not proof that Proton alone caused the crash.

guides.title: A game launcher opens but the game does not
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not enter account credentials into a diagnostic log.
comparison: Check whether failure happens in the game's separate launcher, authentication, or final game process.
Note which stage displays an error and whether another game using the same launcher works.
interpretations: Launcher and game executable failures need to be distinguished.

guides.title: A game reports an unsupported graphics API
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not replace Vulkan or GPU drivers without confirming the graphics environment.
comparison: Check the exact DirectX, Vulkan, or OpenGL error shown by the game.
Compare whether another game using the same graphics API starts normally.
interpretations: A missing API message does not establish whether the problem is a driver, runtime, or game requirement.

guides.title: Steam Proton is missing from compatibility choices
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not install untrusted custom Proton builds just to populate the list.
comparison: Check whether Steam Play is available and whether the compatibility tool appears in Steam Properties.
Check whether the Proton tool download or installed library is incomplete.
interpretations: Missing choices can reflect installation, update, or game compatibility settings.

guides.title: A custom Proton version does not appear
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not overwrite Valve's Proton files or move unknown archives into the install folder.
comparison: Check whether the custom tool was installed for the Steam instance you are actually using.
Check whether Steam was fully restarted after adding that tool.
interpretations: A tool not listed is not evidence that its executable is incompatible.

guides.title: Steam Linux Runtime fails to start
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not manually remove Steam Linux Runtime directories before identifying the error.
comparison: Check the actual Steam Runtime error or diagnostic output for the failing title.
Compare with a different Linux-native or Proton game if one is already installed.
interpretations: Steam Linux Runtime failure is different from a missing system package and may involve its container.

guides.title: A game fails after switching Proton versions
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete compatibility data to reset a title without protecting saves.
comparison: Check the selected Proton version and whether the old version still appears installed.
Compare the error stage with the last successful run, noting launch options if configured.
interpretations: Switching compatibility tools may change prefix behavior; the error must be attributed carefully.

guides.title: A Windows game has an anti-cheat error
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not disable security tools or attempt to bypass anti-cheat.
comparison: Check the exact anti-cheat message and whether the game's publisher supports Linux/Proton.
Check whether the failure occurs before or after joining multiplayer.
interpretations: Some games do not support their anti-cheat setup under Proton; there may be no local fix.

guides.title: A Proton game reports missing DLL or library
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not download DLL files from random websites.
comparison: Record the exact filename and whether the error appears inside Proton or in a native program.
Check the game's installed-files verification status without changing anything yet.
interpretations: A Windows DLL issue and a missing native Linux shared library are different problems.

guides.title: A game uses the wrong GPU
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change system-wide GPU switching until the actual renderer is identified.
comparison: Compare the game renderer and chosen GPU with another known working title.
Check whether the issue is specific to a hybrid-GPU laptop, external GPU, or only one game.
interpretations: An unexpected GPU does not prove a graphics hardware fault.

guides.title: Game performance is much worse than expected
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Avoid promising one graphics tweak as a universal performance fix.
comparison: Check whether slowdown is confined to one game and whether the system is thermally or memory constrained.
Compare a known working graphics workload and note whether the game is installing shaders.
interpretations: Low FPS can involve a game engine, CPU, GPU, storage, power profile, or compatibility layer.

guides.title: A game stutters while shaders are processed
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not clear shader caches or game files without a clear reason.
comparison: Check whether stutters happen during the first play session, after updates, or every launch.
Compare CPU and storage activity with the affected game closed.
interpretations: Shader processing can cause temporary load, but persistent stutter has other possible causes.

guides.title: A game has screen tearing or uneven frames
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change monitor refresh rates globally without checking a second application.
comparison: Check whether tearing occurs only in fullscreen, windowed mode, or across the desktop.
Compare the affected display's selected refresh rate and the game's video settings.
interpretations: A frame pacing symptom is not proof of a defective monitor or GPU.

guides.title: A game opens on the wrong monitor
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not reset the desktop display layout just to move a single game window.
comparison: Check which display the game selects and whether the desktop still identifies both monitors.
Compare windowed and fullscreen behavior if the game supports it.
interpretations: A game choosing the wrong display does not necessarily indicate a system display failure.

guides.title: Gamepad works in Steam but not in the game
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change global controller mappings without saving the current layout.
comparison: Check whether Steam sees controller input in its own interface or controller test.
Compare game-specific Steam Input settings and whether the game supports that controller type.
interpretations: Input working in Steam but not in one game points to a mapping or compatibility difference, not a missing USB connection.

guides.title: Steam cannot detect my controller
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete Bluetooth pairings or USB device permissions without a reason.
comparison: Check whether Linux detects the controller in Manual Diagnostics under Peripherals & Devices.
If Linux sees it, check whether Steam's controller settings identify the same device.
interpretations: Steam detection and Linux hardware detection are different tests.

guides.title: Controller buttons are mapped incorrectly in Steam
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Save or document any custom Steam Input layout before editing it.
comparison: Check whether the wrong mapping affects all games or one game's controller layout.
Compare the visible Steam Input mapping with the buttons expected by the affected game.
interpretations: Incorrect mapping does not prove a hardware problem.

guides.title: Steam game audio is missing
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Start with a low volume to avoid loud sound when audio returns.
comparison: Check whether other applications play sound and which audio device the game selects.
Compare whether Steam itself has sound while only the game is silent.
interpretations: A game-specific audio route does not establish a broken sound device.

guides.title: Steam voice chat microphone is not working
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not record or share private voice conversations as test evidence.
comparison: Check the selected microphone in Steam and the desktop's current input device.
Check whether microphone access is blocked for a sandboxed Steam installation.
interpretations: A recognized microphone does not prove voice-chat capture works.

guides.title: Steam streaming has no picture
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change desktop capture permissions without reviewing their scope.
comparison: Check whether Remote Play connects but shows a black frame, or never connects at all.
Compare the host game window with the streamed output and note the desktop session type.
interpretations: Capture, encoding, and network problems cannot be distinguished by a black frame alone.

guides.title: Steam Remote Play cannot connect
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not open inbound firewall ports without confirming the exact requirement.
comparison: Check whether both devices appear online in Steam and whether pairing succeeds.
Compare connection attempts on the same local network before changing router settings.
interpretations: Remote Play connection errors may involve discovery, routing, firewall, or account state.

guides.title: Steam Remote Play has no sound
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Keep volume low when switching outputs.
comparison: Check the host game's audio and the receiving device's selected output independently.
If the video stream works, compare audio with another streaming title if available.
interpretations: Video working does not confirm that audio is routed or encoded correctly.

guides.title: Steam Cloud says files are out of sync
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Back up valuable local saves before accepting a conflict choice.
comparison: Check whether the message names one game and whether Steam reports a local-versus-cloud conflict.
Keep the newest verified save copy rather than choosing blindly based on a timestamp alone.
interpretations: Sync errors are not proof that a local save is corrupt; a wrong choice can overwrite progress.

guides.title: Game progress is missing after cloud sync
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not overwrite or delete the remaining local save files.
comparison: Check whether the game supports Steam Cloud and whether your other device has a newer save.
Compare local and remote timestamps only after making a backup.
interpretations: Some games use different save locations or do not sync all data across platforms.

guides.title: Steam screenshots are missing
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not clear Steam userdata or caches while searching for screenshots.
comparison: Check whether the game uses Steam's screenshot feature and whether the screenshot is listed in Steam.
Compare the expected screenshot location for this Steam installation with the actual one.
interpretations: Screenshots stored in a different profile or library can look lost without being deleted.

guides.title: Steam workshop download never finishes
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete subscribed workshop files while a download is running.
comparison: Check whether the problem affects one workshop item or all subscribed content.
Check whether Steam's download queue reports a server, disk, or verification problem.
interpretations: Workshop synchronization problems need not have the same cause as game downloads.

guides.title: Mods work in one Steam game but not another
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Back up game files and mod settings before making changes.
comparison: Check how the affected title loads mods and whether its install location changed.
Compare game version and mod compatibility instead of copying another game's configuration.
interpretations: Game-specific mod loaders differ; a working mod in one title does not guarantee another title supports it.

guides.title: Steam Family Sharing game will not launch
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not modify account or family settings to bypass licensing restrictions.
comparison: Check the exact Steam message: availability, ownership, compatibility, or a startup error.
Confirm the game is included in the relevant sharing arrangement before testing Proton.
interpretations: An unavailable shared title is not automatically a Linux compatibility problem.

guides.title: Steam achievements are not unlocking
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete local game saves or force achievements by modifying files.
comparison: Check whether the game supports those achievements and whether Steam is online.
Compare achievements in one affected game with another title that has already recorded them.
interpretations: Achievements may depend on game events and synchronization; no local service failure is proven.

guides.title: Steam VR game will not start
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not change headset firmware or VR device permissions without an identified need.
comparison: Check whether the headset and runtime are recognized outside the game.
Check the title's Linux and VR runtime requirements before comparing Proton settings.
interpretations: Unsupported VR runtimes and game incompatibility are not necessarily hardware defects.

guides.title: Steam on Wayland has input or window issues
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Avoid switching the entire desktop session without first narrowing the affected application.
comparison: Check whether the issue affects Steam menus, games, pop-up windows, or input capture.
Compare an ordinary desktop app and note whether Steam runs in an XWayland window.
interpretations: Wayland and XWayland integration can differ across desktops and games.

guides.title: Steam does not launch a game from an external disk
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not reformat an external disk to solve a game-launch problem.
comparison: Check that the library drive is currently mounted and accessible to the Steam installation.
Check its filesystem and permission limits without altering mount options.
interpretations: Some storage configurations limit executable behavior or filename expectations; a present game directory alone is insufficient.

guides.title: Steam library storage is filling the home folder
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not delete Proton compatibility data or shader caches without checking what they contain.
comparison: Compare free space in your home directory and the library drives listed in Steam.
Identify whether temporary downloads, shader data, or compatibility data account for most growth.
interpretations: Steam cache and compatibility data can use home storage even when games are on another disk.

guides.title: Steam game stops responding after suspend
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not force a system reset unless normal recovery is unavailable.
comparison: Check whether the entire desktop is unresponsive or only the running game is frozen.
Compare audio and other windows after resume before attributing the problem to the GPU.
interpretations: A game freeze after resume does not prove the graphics driver crashed.

guides.title: Steam content reports connection timed out
guides.heading: Steam
precautions: Do not restart the router solely because one Steam request timed out.
comparison: Check whether the timeout affects downloads, account sign-in, or multiplayer only.
Compare an already-working browser connection with the affected Steam feature.
interpretations: A timeout in one Steam service is not evidence of a total internet outage.
